visual.name: smartVisualsFlowChart
visual.description: Flow chart and process map built from your data: level columns, from-to pairs or an event log (case, activity, timestamp). Loops, link labels, collapse and expand, search, drilldown, top variants and average time per step are free. Premium adds process mining lite: median and P90 durations, waiting vs processing time, bottleneck heat, SLA flags, rework, conformance to a reference path, swimlanes, KPI vs target and period comparison.
